title: On the Dual Drazin Inverse of Adjacency Matrices of Dual-number-Weighted Digraphs
summary: The motivation of this paper is to investigate the dual Drazin inverse of adjacency matrices arising from several classes of connected dual-number-weighted digraphs over the dual complex algebra. Explicit formulas for the dual Drazin inverse of dual complex anti-triangular block matrices are derived under suitable assumptions. These results are applied to DN-DS digraphs, DN-DLS digraphs, and DN-DW digraphs.
